comment: Japan CPI series missing from chart despite appearing in legend — rendering bug. Both series must be visible when two countries are compared.
Japan CPI 'Nu' value shows -0.500 which is incorrect for YoY headline CPI (should be ~2-4% range). Likely pulling wrong FRED series or month-on-month instead of YoY.
Y-axis labelled 'Indeks (2015=100)' but data shows QoQ growth rates oscillating around zero. Either fix the series to show actual index levels or fix the label to say growth rates.
Values of -0.143 and 0.453 are QoQ growth rates, not index levels. Mislabelled — consistent with Figure 06 issue.
